usage: Choose Invoice Document in the Streamlit UI and upload the source image.
Copy one case.base_evidence object into Structured PO / GR / payment JSON.
Apply the case.ocr_field_reviews actions during extraction confirmation.
Compare the final decision with case.expected.
_meta.warning: Only TC14 is fully faithful to the attached service invoice. Other cases add synthetic PO/GR/payment/history or contradict visible values to exercise policy branches.
_meta.current_ui_limitation: The current Streamlit extraction form confirms header fields but does not expose line-item review controls; line_items[...] overrides are executable through the OCR harness but not fully through the current manual UI.
